name: dynamic-bridged
message: width is set at runtime through --dsaF

name: unsplittable-shorthand
message: padding cannot be split, so it stays one shorthand atom; if a later style removes one of its longhands, the remaining longhands receive this whole value, which is only valid for a single component
help: write the longhands instead when a later style removes some of them

name: target-lowering
message: the stylesheet is lowered for targets below the default floor
